opencode-go._windows_note: USD-equivalent ceilings for the OpenCode Go subscription (builder and solo only, the two agents below on adapter opencode/provider opencode-go). This block is enforced directly (docs/architecture.md 'Configuration'; docs/guards.md 'Provider quota ceilings: config vs. quota:set'): src/limits.mjs's checkQuota seeds/refreshes matching provider_quota rows from this JSON and enforces them as an admission gate at run:start, reconciled at ingest -- no quota:set call required. The three quota:set commands in docs/measurement.md's 'OpenCode Go as the builder lane' section are an optional override, not a prerequisite: useful for pinning a ceiling for this one deployment, and once run that row wins over this config for the same (provider, model, window kind) permanently, until quota:set is used again.

google._note: reviewer's lab: chosen to differ from builder/solo's OpenCode Go lane and from reviewer_b's lab (docs/review-protocol.md 'Roles', provider rule). No window is declared here -- this provider is not USD-equivalent subscription metered the way opencode-go is; add quota:set windows if the operator's own account has a hard cap worth enforcing.

openai._note: reviewer_b's lab (PR triage mode only, docs/review-protocol.md): a third lab, different again from builder/solo and from reviewer. No window declared here for the same reason as google above.

builder._model_note: Placeholder. The operator sets this to a model available on their OpenCode Go plan. Must not contain 'anthropic' or 'claude' (src/adapters/opencode.mjs refuses those with exit 1 -- Anthropic subscription OAuth may not be used inside a third party harness).

solo._model_note: Placeholder, and it must be set to the exact same value as builder.model above. solo is the control arm's build agent standing in for 'no reviewer' (docs/measurement.md: 'agent solo, same provider and model as the builder, its own agent definition'), not a different model -- changing the model here would confound the comparison compare is meant to make.

reviewer._model_note: Placeholder. The operator sets this. It must be a different lab from builder/solo's OpenCode Go model, so the review is actually independent, not just a second call to the same model (same convention as community/agents/blind-reviewer/config.json's model placeholder). Reached through the operator's own Google credentials configured in OpenCode, separate from the OpenCode Go subscription.

reviewer_b._model_note: Placeholder. PR triage mode's second blind reviewer (docs/review-protocol.md). Must be a third lab, different from both builder/solo's OpenCode Go model and reviewer's Google model. Runs through the Codex CLI against the operator's own OpenAI account.
